issues.problem: 'A screenshot can't see that.' sets up a weak contrast. Nobody debugs perf bugs from screenshots. The viewer's real question is 'I already record sessions or videos, so why is this different?' Both sides are 'recordings', and the line misses the chance to say why Replay's recording is different. TIME-17 states exactly that: a DOM/screen recording has nothing to show for 25 renders that changed nothing on screen.
issues.fix: L0506 'A screen recording can't see that. Replay's time-travel recording can.' (+1 word; generic, no competitor named; TIME-17 is a labelled inference, so keep it unattributed and plain). On screen, change the drawn 'screenshot' frame to a small video-frame outline with a ▶ glyph so it matches.

'Some bugs only exist in time' leads to a real 67 ms / four-dropped-frames bug with no click, then 'Twenty-five of twenty-seven renders changed nothing on screen', then a named 'time-travel recording', then a match cut to the real Root Cause line. Everything stays real and specific: the bug titles, chips, schedule chip, PR badges and Insights tiles are actual recording frames with verified crops and marks, and the open/fixed status is kept honest (the 'Open' chip is pinned on the 67 ms bug).
